name: Samuhia Desk
audience: Approved desk agents, and the chamas, schools and landlords they support
description: A secure workspace where approved agents set up, support and collect for chamas, schools and landlords, and are paid automatically.
longDescription: Samuhia Desk is the workspace for approved Samuhia agents. With a customer's one-time code, an agent opens their MyChama, MyRegister or Plot Yangu account, imports or enters records, schedules SMS, runs reports and collects rent. Customers pay fixed prices by M-Pesa, and Paystack splits each payment so the agent's share reaches their payout account automatically.
problem: Many chamas, schools and landlords want to go digital but lack the time or skills to load records, set up reminders and run reports. Local people they trust could help, but there has been no safe, paid way to do it.
features: One-time-code access to a customer's account, only with their permission
Excel import of members, students or tenants for a flat KES 200
Manual entry for paper records, priced by number of records
Schedule setup and bulk SMS reminders for KES 100
Reports and data exports run for the customers you support
Rent collection by M-Pesa prompt for Plot Yangu tenants
Support visits logged and confirmed by the customer with a code
Requests inbox: help requests from MyChama, MyRegister and Plot Yangu reach the right desk
Earnings dashboard with commissions, service income, payables and refund reversals
Automatic Paystack split at the moment the customer pays
Application, document upload, training and activation inside the app
steps: An agent applies, uploads ID documents and sets a payout account.
Samuhia reviews, trains and activates the desk.
A customer asks for help and reads the agent a one-time code.
The agent completes the job in the app and the customer pays the fixed price by M-Pesa.
Paystack splits the payment and the agent's share is paid automatically. Earnings update in the dashboard.

faq.q: Is Samuhia Desk an official government service?
faq.a: No. It is a Samuhia workspace for approved agents who help customers with digital workflows. It is not a government platform.

faq.q: How can an agent open a customer's account?
faq.a: Only with the customer's permission. The customer receives a one-time code by SMS and reads it to the agent, who enters it in the app.

Each customer payment is split by Paystack after its fees, and the agent's share is sent to the agent's payout account. Refunds are handled by Paystack and appear as reversals in the agent's earnings.

faq.q: Can I become a desk agent?
faq.a: Yes. Apply in the app, upload your documents and complete Samuhia's training. Desk agents are independent and commission-based, with no salary or guaranteed income.
